description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for order-related API endpoints in an e-commerce backend system. It sets up various routes for creating orders, listing own or all orders, retrieving specific orders by ID, and updating order status, with appropriate middleware for authentication, authorization, validation, and documentation via Swagger annotations.

methods.name: orderRoutes.post
methods.description: Route handler for creating a new order with POST /

methods.name: orderRoutes.get('/my')
methods.description: Route handler for listing the current user's orders with GET /my

methods.name: orderRoutes.get('/')
methods.description: Route handler for listing all orders (admin only) with GET /

methods.name: orderRoutes.get('/:id')
methods.description: Route handler for retrieving an order by ID with GET /:id

methods.name: orderRoutes.patch('/:id/status')
methods.description: Route handler for updating an order's status with PATCH /:id/status
